title: Anthropic just raised 10 billion and here is their plan

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Anthropic’s $10B raise isn’t just funding—it’s a strategic investment in aligned AI, with clear roadmap for safe, scalable deployment.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But "just" raises a red flag—$10B without transparency or open oversight risks creating another closed-door AI monopoly.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Their Constitutional AI protocol ensures alignment checks at every layer, backed by rigorous safety testing and human-in-the-loop systems.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even with protocols, Anthropic’s lack of open-source access and limited external audits makes real accountability impossible.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This isn’t progress—it’s power consolidation under the guise of innovation.
